pages.en: There is a big tree in Lily's garden. In spring, it has small green leaves and pink flowers. Birds sing in it.
pages.zh: Lily 的花园里有一棵大树。春天，树上长出小小的绿叶和粉红色的花，鸟儿在树上唱歌。
pages.scene: A big tree in a garden in spring with fresh green leaves and pink blossom, two little birds singing on a branch, Lily looking up.

pages.en: In summer, the tree is green and the family has lunch under it. In autumn, the leaves are red and brown, and Tom plays in them.
pages.zh: 夏天，树绿油油的，一家人在树下吃午饭。秋天，树叶变成了红色和棕色，Tom 在落叶里玩。
pages.scene: The same big tree split into two halves: on the left in summer, green, with the family having a picnic under it; on the right in autumn, red and brown leaves, Tom jumping in a pile of leaves.

pages.en: In winter, there are no leaves, and there is snow on the tree. Lily and Tom play in the snow under it. "I love my tree in every season!" says Lily.
pages.zh: 冬天，树叶掉光了，树上积着雪。Lily 和 Tom 在树下玩雪。“我每个季节都爱我的树！”Lily 说。
pages.scene: The same big tree in winter with bare branches covered in snow, Lily and Tom throwing snowballs under it, Max jumping in the snow.

questions.q: The tree has pink flowers in spring.
questions.zh: 春天树上开着粉红色的花。

questions.q: What do Lily and Tom do in winter?
questions.zh: 冬天 Lily 和 Tom 做什么？

questions.q: The leaves are green in autumn.
